# DrifterApps.Seeds

> Opinionated building blocks for DDD / Vertical Slice Architecture ASP.NET Core applications on .NET 10. Five packages: strongly-typed IDs and aggregate contracts, validated query pagination, authorization composition, MediatR pipeline behaviors, Hangfire scheduling, and shared test infrastructure. Fallible operations return `Result<T>` (`DrifterApps.Seeds.FluentResult`) instead of throwing.

Packages:
- `DrifterApps.Seeds.Domain` — namespace `DrifterApps.Seeds.Domain`
- `DrifterApps.Seeds.Application` — namespace `DrifterApps.Seeds.Application`
- `DrifterApps.Seeds.Application.Mediatr` — namespace `DrifterApps.Seeds.Application.Mediatr`
- `DrifterApps.Seeds.Infrastructure` — namespace `DrifterApps.Seeds.Infrastructure`
- `DrifterApps.Seeds.Testing` — namespace `DrifterApps.Seeds.Testing`

Companion libraries: `DrifterApps.Seeds.FluentResult`, `DrifterApps.Seeds.FluentScenario`

- [Domain](src/Domain/README.md): `IAggregateRoot`, `IRepository<T>`, `IUnitOfWork`, `StronglyTypedId<T>`
- [Application](src/Application/README.md): `QueryParams`, authorization requirements, endpoint filters, converters
- [Application.Mediatr](src/Application.Mediatr/README.md): `LoggingBehavior`, `UnitOfWorkBehavior`, `ValidationBehavior`
- [Infrastructure](src/Infrastructure/README.md): Hangfire `IRequestScheduler`, Refit helpers
- [Testing](src/Testing/README.md): `FakerBuilder<T>`, `DatabaseDriver<TDbContext>`, `WireMockDriver`, `AuthorityDriver`, trait attributes
